up: Retrieve exact IC50 values (standard_relation must be '=') for compounds tested against the human protein target 'Cytochrome P450 2D6'. For each matching activity row, return: 1) compound_chembl_id (ChEMBL ID of the compound), 2) canonical_smiles, 3) compound_key, 4) pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID if available, else DOI), 5) assay_description, 6) target_name, 7) organism, 8) standard_value (IC50 in nM). Ensure the target organism is Homo sapiens (tax_id 9606). Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key AS compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS organism, a.standard_value AS standard_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2D6' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
